moa.t: Reduces hepatic gluconeogenesis and increases peripheral insulin sensitivity, does not cause hypoglycaemia alone

dosing_note: Doses are extracted automatically from the guideline text. Each heading is the nearest section title in the guideline and can be off by one section – confirm on the cited page. The pathway dose stays authoritative for its indication.

items.t: Metformin, oral, 500 mg daily. · Increase dose to 500 mg 12 hourly after 7 days. · Titrate dose to a maximum of 850 mg 8 hourly according to glucose
Metformin, oral, 500 mg twice daily with meals. · Adjust dose based on fasting blood glucose levels and/or HbA1c to a maximum dose of 850 mg 8 hourly.
Metformin, oral, 500 mg twice daily with meals. · Titrate dose slowly depending on HbA1c and/or fasting blood glucose levels to a maximum dose of 850 mg 8 hourly.
Metformin initiation: • Initiate metformin at a low dose (500 mg or 1000 mg total daily dose), titrating up as needed. Do not exceed 2 g daily.

Metformin is safe in pregnancy and should not be stopped. · Note that metformin interacts with dolutegravir, and the maximum dose of metformin for women on dolutegravir is 500mg twice a day.

contraindications.t: Acute illness with hypoxia, sepsis, dehydration or shock

cautions.t: Withhold around iodinated contrast and during acute illness

adverse_effects.t: Nausea, diarrhoea, abdominal discomfort, metallic taste, vitamin B12 deficiency, lactic acidosis (rare)

monitoring.t: Renal function, HbA1c, B12 long term
